method: Independent Python reference: stateless modular power versus per-row streaming quotient/remainder; full and split descending-j traversals, incomplete last rows and tiny requests.
production_changes: none; candidate for stage6 after PGO
stateless_formula: For index=i*l+j: r=2^(T-k*(index+1)) mod B; bucket=floor((r*2^k)/B).
recurrence: For descending j, the next exponent increases by k. Compute (bucket,next_remainder)=divmod(remainder*2^k,B) and reuse next_remainder for the same i row at j-1.
planned_layout: Private per-worker row remainders, initialized with FastPow at the first eligible j in each row. Two worker halves initialize independently; partial last rows may become eligible later. O(ceil(T/(k*l))) remainder storage; retain stateless GetBlock as independent reference. Quotient/remainder must be distinct mpz values; remainder may alias dividend if GMP permits.
